scan.title: What Is on the Farm?
scan.subtitle: Find the right animal or building!
sentences: Leo's grandparents live on a farm!
There is a big farmhouse on the farm.
There is also a barn next to the farmhouse.
How many cows are there? There are four cows.
There are two horses and three donkeys.
How many sheep are there? There are six sheep.
There are five goats and two ducks.
There is a turkey near the barn.
There are ten chickens on the farm.
There are also three rabbits near the farmhouse.
Leo says: What a big and wonderful farm!
translations: Leo'nun büyükannesi ve büyükbabası bir çiftlikte yaşıyor!
Çiftlikte büyük bir çiftlik evi var.
Çiftlik evinin yanında bir ahır da var.
Kaç inek var? Dört inek var.
İki at ve üç eşek var.
Kaç koyun var? Altı koyun var.
Beş keçi ve iki ördek var.
Ahırın yanında bir hindi var.
Çiftlikte on tavuk var.
Çiftlik evinin yanında üç tavşan da var.
Leo diyor: Ne büyük ve harika bir çiftlik!

sentences: There are many chores on a farm every day!

Leo's aunt always collects the eggs in the morning.

Leo's grandfather often gardens near the farmhouse.

skim.subtitle: Read quickly and find the main idea!
sentences: It is a beautiful morning on the farm today.
Look at the farm now! Everyone is busy.
Leo's grandfather is milking the cows at present.
Leo's grandmother is feeding the chickens now.
Leo's uncle is watering the plants in the field at present.
Leo's aunt is collecting the eggs near the barn today.
Maya asks: What is Leo doing now?
Leo is helping his grandfather at present.
Maya says: How beautiful! The farm is so busy!
Leo says: Fantastic! I love mornings on the farm!

inf.title: A Day at the Village Farm
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: Ms. Hart visits Leo's village farm with Maya and Leo.
Every morning, Leo's grandfather milks the cows and feeds the sheep.
But at present, he is not doing his usual chores.
He is planting vegetables in the big field now.
Leo's grandmother always collects eggs and feeds the chickens every morning.
But today she is watering the plants near the cottage.
Ms. Hart asks: Why not do the usual chores today?
Leo says: It is spring! We plant and grow things in spring.
Ms. Hart looks at the green grass and the beautiful fields.
She says: Fantastic! No way! This village is so beautiful!
Maya thinks: In spring, farmers plant instead of their usual chores.
Maya says: Now I understand why Leo loves the farm!
translations: Ms. Hart, Maya ve Leo ile Leo'nun köy çiftliğini ziyaret ediyor.
Her sabah Leo'nun büyükbabası inekleri sağar ve koyunları besler.
Ama şu an olağan işlerini yapmıyor.
Şimdi büyük tarlaya sebze ekiyor.
Leo'nun büyükannesi her sabah yumurta toplar ve tavukları besler.
Ama bugün kulübenin yanındaki bitkileri sulıyor.
Ms. Hart soruyor: Neden bugün olağan işleri yapmıyorsunuz?
Leo diyor: İlkbahar! İlkbaharda ekip büyütüyoruz.
Ms. Hart yeşil çimene ve güzel tarlalara bakıyor.
Diyor: Harika! İnanılmaz! Bu köy çok güzel!
Maya düşünüyor: İlkbaharda çiftçiler olağan işleri yerine ekiyor.
Maya diyor: Şimdi Leo'nun çiftliği neden sevdiğini anlıyorum!
